integrity: Proof includes an exhaustive fixed-domain Python checker and a separate Eulerian-circuit enumeration; its output was reproduced in the self-review.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite order-five enumeration only; lower-bound first-gap comparison restricted to orders two through five. Unindexed prior finite enumerations remain a priority risk. No independent proof audit.
title: Exact Burrows–Wheeler run spectrum of binary de Bruijn cycles of order five
